headline: NextEra Energy (NEE) Tops Q2 Earnings Estimates
summary: NextEra (NEE) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +5.51% and -5.76%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
